checklist_quote_checks.quote: DO NOT call the judge's office to request hearing time.
This Court's requirement of conferral is broader than that included in Rule 1.202, Florida Rules of Civil Procedure.
DO NOT MAIL HARD COPIES OR A BINDER OF CASE LAW OR OTHER HEARING MATERIALS unless specifically directed by the judicial assistant.
Any proposed order not complying with the above instructions will not be entered.
The judge's office will not mail out copies of any orders.

all specially set hearings (not including the Court's Motion Calendar Docket) will be held IN PERSON (not via Zoom) at the Bay County Courthouse, unless the Court specifically grants a request to appear via Zoom
Only email the judicial assistant to request dates and confirm the hearing date. DO NOT include the judicial assistant in email chains between counsel and/or staff to clear dates (or anything else).
